unbalanced_probability:
theorem unbalanced_probability : polyaNext [true,true,true] = (4 : ℝ)/5 ∧
    polyaNext [true,true,true] ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) 1
correlated_two_step_masses:
theorem correlated_two_step_masses :
    pathWeight [true,true] = (1 : ℝ)/3 ∧ pathWeight [false,false] = (1 : ℝ)/3 ∧
    pathWeight [true,false] = (1 : ℝ)/6 ∧ pathWeight [false,true] = (1 : ℝ)/6
zero_and_two_normalization:
theorem zero_and_two_normalization :
    (∑ v : List.Vector Bool 0, pathWeight v.toList) = 1 ∧
    (∑ v : List.Vector Bool 2, pathWeight v.toList) = 1
correlated_moments:
theorem correlated_moments :
    pathExpectation 2 (fun h => (h.count true : ℝ)) = 1 ∧
    pathExpectation 2 (fun h => (h.count true : ℝ)^2) = (5 : ℝ)/3
averaged_variance:
theorem averaged_variance :
    pathExpectation 2 (fun h => polyaNext h * (1-polyaNext h)) = (5 : ℝ)/24
same_past_different_current:
theorem same_past_different_current :
    causalPredict polyaNext (binaryStream [true,false]) 1 =
      causalPredict polyaNext (binaryStream [false,false]) 1
seeded_policy_bounds: theorem seeded_policy_bounds : ∀ b h, seededPolicy b h ∈ Icc (0 : ℝ) 1
genuine_coin_policy:
theorem genuine_coin_policy :
    seededPolicy true [] = 1 ∧ seededPolicy false [] = 0 ∧
    coinMeasure {true} = (1 : ENNReal)/2 ∧ coinMeasure {false} = (1 : ENNReal)/2
seeded_fixed_sequence_endpoint:
theorem seeded_fixed_sequence_endpoint :
    ∃ v : List.Vector Bool 2, (11 : ℝ)/36 ≤ ∫ b, pathRegret (seededPolicy b) v.toList ∂coinMeasure
seeded_log_endpoint:
theorem seeded_log_endpoint :
    ∃ v : List.Vector Bool 2, Real.log 4 / 6 ≤ ∫ b, pathRegret (seededPolicy b) v.toList ∂coinMeasure
deterministic_fixed_sequence_endpoint:
theorem deterministic_fixed_sequence_endpoint (T : ℕ) (hT : 0 < T) :
    ∃ v : List.Vector Bool T, Real.log ((T : ℝ)+2)/6 ≤ pathRegret polyaNext v.toList
